description: Use after find_businesses to see what a business sells or books, with prices and options. The owner-approved catalog: items in categories, each with a price (fixed, from, or to confirm, per unit), option groups (pick one, up to N, any; a choice may add price or time, set the price like a size, or multiply it), typed fields to ask, and fulfillment (appointment, reservation, pickup, delivery, onsite, request, elsewhere: bought on its own page, product_url). `team` names who can be asked for, and `next` says which tools complete each fulfillment. Prices from/confirm are estimates. Not live stock. For one item or a long catalog, pass query (words in its name or description) and read more with page.next_offset.

limit.description: How many to return (default 25, at most 100)

offset.description: Skip this many matches: page.next_offset from the last answer

query.description: Words in the item's name or description, e.g. "onkyo receiver": only matching items come back

name: catalog
title: Read a business’s catalog
